02C8970E-455C-4660-B92B-4B4AF79E336B.blurb: It's 1986, and you're in New York pitching your own "Create Your Own Narrative" book to the legendary S.B. Birmingham. Vampires, or sports?

05276DAD-634B-4824-A321-132D1A218DEF.blurb: Sebastian, a large orange cat and a very well-dressed rogue, has put on his best suit. Today he will stop the Birds, or escape the Woodrich Home for good.

110F0D44-5E0C-4E58-BE11-2E5617169961.blurb: You are a newly emerged honeybee on your first day out of the cell. Your sisters all have jobs to do. You want to be useful, but where to start? And you're hungry.

151D90D3-A3DC-49F9-84D6-16BF737A6283.blurb: A week house-sitting your great-aunt's Victorian mansion, with only Mr. Twinkles, her ancient calico, for company. The storm is picking up, and the house won't stop groaning.

1603D07C-4502-4CFB-B57A-8215F3368363.blurb: Hello, Winter! A family camping trip in the Colorado Rockies, a raven-like bird with huge glowing yellow eyes, and a squawk that sounds a lot like "follow me."

179BA955-66FB-4EA1-8159-AD47671217E9.blurb: Neon in the puddles, a scream from an alley, and a young woman waiting in your office who wants to hire you. A rain-soaked private-eye story.

1803C70D-4E62-4709-8597-A4B77D31EEDE.blurb: You've made it to the Wrestlefest Performance Center, one step from superstardom and your own action figure. Now you just need a gimmick the fans will love.

18397F98-65DE-4345-B77A-7DF71B2070AC.blurb: A sweltering school trip to the ruins of Pompeii, a guide droning on about Emperor Augustus, and one archway that looks newer than all the rest.

1B930522-9A51-4211-840F-FFC2A98A0744.blurb: Madison Square Garden is screaming for a third encore, but you've been on tour for fourteen months and you're dead tired. Every choice from here changes your rock-and-roll life.

22C52A7C-F35F-4933-847A-CBFD30F44951.blurb: A concrete room, a revolver, and a reward for anyone who keeps playing long enough. How many bullets will you load?

2535856F-1877-4FA2-A045-F8536A5CC1A4.blurb: YOU ARE A ROBOT. How awesome is that? A cheerfully argumentative story with big plans for you, if you'll only go along with them.

30E6B0CE-F05A-44DF-A53F-6AA2CD3B7F7A.blurb: Your band Groove Driver is opening for Toto at the county fairgrounds. All you have to do is get up, find your instrument and, as your lead singer keeps reminding you, stick to the downbeat.

336CD74A-4DDC-46D8-885D-145C88417F29.blurb: After a long and lovely stay, you're finally checking out. Your exceedingly polite hosts just need one last decision from you first.

3388B934-D7FC-4043-968C-47CF1F96EEE1.blurb: Join KeeKee, the adventurous calico kitty, in her hot air balloon above the clouds. Paris or Rome? There are friends to meet and landmarks to bump into.

3A038DAC-4C6A-4571-A7BE-E2265D5E66AA.blurb: Beyond the ridge, the rolling fortress of Ur'ell grinds through the valley on six giant treads. Your brother Aleron is imprisoned inside, and you and your steed Drumfire have come for him.

3ED416D6-5A89-49AD-B59B-1EC3073BBE40.blurb: You are John Stamos. One morning, toothbrush in hand, you ask yourself what your greatest accomplishment is, and the day goes somewhere nobody could have predicted.

47932F90-F664-487E-89E6-12F48FDE00EA.blurb: Your first day working for an actual mastermind. The interviews were vague about whether he's good or evil, and the secret agent loose in the building isn't helping.

479B0C32-5BD3-489B-A351-46D65E744F6E.blurb: Stench, Boogs and Toxic have trained on the same playground since first grade, until it is replaced overnight with foam and plastic. Which of their nemeses is behind it?

479B6E16-A35A-4603-AF55-7066D647D8C3.blurb: Reading Moby-Dick, you learn that Germans once believed the spine was a string of undeveloped skulls. It gets you thinking: about your mother, your boyfriend, and that time in grade school.

4CA78148-69E7-4375-BDD0-9E406BB0342A.blurb: Hero, a mighty Yorkshire terrier, offers his services to a fair maiden who has burst into his dog shed. Thou shalt be gallant, and thou mayest scratch behind his ear.

4E386275-7104-47A2-BE24-16BF127056D8.blurb: A stranger is shambling down the street toward you, moaning. He might be hurt and need your help. He might be something else. The title might be a clue.

50269C21-8F52-4FCE-8FA7-186E2EB94AFC.blurb: You wake up in blinding heat with your head throbbing and your leg pinned under something. Then you meet Zrrr, who is very, very sorry about all this.

56DD37B2-BE6F-403D-9529-1819B2EEF47A.blurb: Walking home through the alley after a long day, you see a woman's purse being snatched. Will you step in, call for help, or hide behind the dumpster?

5E5FE4F0-0A6C-4E2F-9B6A-BA5CE01B55A9.blurb: Today you have to enroll in a new university course, which means leaving the apartment, which means people. Your mind has plenty of other ideas.

60AF3E50-BC5F-4AE6-9803-34ECC9CAA9B6.blurb: It's 1997, and you've just hatched inside a plastic egg. Your whole world is a 32 × 16 pixel pen, and how your life goes depends on the mood of whoever is holding you.

6417C59D-3F74-466F-87D1-5C42379F9987.blurb: In THE FUTURE, Earth is united under SkyMall, and you are a laser-mop virtuoso of the Transportation Sanitary Administration. That promotion is very, very close.

64864B03-0F9C-4B91-8B80-0651B76CE94B.blurb: You're a psychic with a real gift, which mostly means the dead won't stop sharing their opinions. Your life already feels like a reality show.

65057DAA-2D70-49D6-B8F8-6B3C9594E3D6.blurb: Driving through the brown fields of Iowa to meet your fiancée's family for the first time, for Thanksgiving. They'll love you, she says. Just don't mention her brother's tattoo.

66727A9F-6F57-4531-BFEE-AA72F985BCE2.blurb: Psst. Something feels weird. Someone is watching us, and the voice in your head won't let it go. A paranoid little conversation with yourself.

6727F3DF-A7C2-4A8C-80C4-69204C85C07A.blurb: Parachute into the evil Dr. Dummkopf's mansion, outwit his puzzle-traps and stop his scheme to keep people from thinking for themselves. Whizz is on the radio if you get stuck.

68CE3DC6-1778-4829-A2DE-D1EDE358E7D6.blurb: Congratulations on your first day as President! Russian tanks have been spotted near the border. You could mobilize the army, call the UN, or have some more champagne.

69B36581-7F24-4135-B197-7A0ED4C9B2EA.blurb: GREETINGS. If you are reading this, you are probably dead. The Management will handle your transition to the afterlife with the utmost dispassion and indifference.

6C5E460A-0BFA-44BD-A9F4-7F5DBA531A08.blurb: After twenty-four years in space, you've finally reached the Planet of Moods. What was your rocket ship's name again?

7C9E3B38-161C-492D-A7C9-7CB7A867EB75.blurb: It's Friday, so you and Ricky are skating the airport luggage carousel. But the automatic doors give you a chill, and people do say the airport was built on an ancient burial ground.

7E22C715-E8AE-45FC-9130-F840F339D87D.blurb: Your grandfather, a world-famous archaeologist, leaves you a letter about the hidden box canyon on his New Mexico ranch, and a gift the two of you share.

913DFFD6-20A5-47B2-B590-A5C8253ECDCD.blurb: You are a microscopic sand plankton on the dry world of Arrakis, and you are very hungry for spice.

9C147CEE-E213-4B76-A4B7-281FEDAA3702.blurb: It's your first Tee Ball game with the Watkins Wildcats. You've got your bat, your glove, your light blue uniform, and an eye out for cool rocks.

9CBD1D2C-C344-4355-AD94-C6D85130974C.blurb: A chilly London evening, a pint with your chums upstairs at The Chandos, and an American in black with something that looks like a bomb and that he swears is a storytelling machine.

A582804D-21E2-4F1F-8837-5B10249DE731.blurb: She walked into my office, legs from floor to sky, with a case for Strawberry Hobbes. A hard-boiled noir with one catch: the office is in a high school.

A9B1F4E5-4127-40B4-9614-D7675207B2B6.blurb: You wake in a dim, empty room with no memory of what came before. A doorway, a small window, and a growing feeling that something here is meant to be solved.

A9FE0C57-94CB-4E00-981B-D575FF804821.blurb: Camp is over and you're driving home, low on gas, on back roads through the cornfields. The corn goes on for miles, and you are not quite alone out here.

AB28C1A7-ACC9-4EB4-B5F4-DEC0146ACBA4.blurb: Your garden is lush with spring rain, and full of slugs. Grab your gear and get to work, go for a barefoot walk, or make toast first.

AF8AA0EB-691E-4F1B-BBDE-294217228F5B.blurb: The room is bright, the walls are colorful, and your wallet is in your hand. Choose a design and a place for it, and remember why.

B4284A95-2977-445C-A831-2929A3C84D14.blurb: Fired by a boss who needed a new Corvette, you're out of work, out of money and out of patience. A dark comedy about getting even, or at least getting by.

BB6E9478-4426-42F0-A893-CBCD8D222DD3.blurb: You are a starwhal, the most majestic, beautiful and vain creature in interstellar space. Choose your gorgeous color, then go hunting.

C33DFD19-6A6B-4955-9879-00B9CA1A5C87.blurb: Everyone gets three lives, and the tally is tattooed on your wrist. It's your sixteenth birthday, your best friend Lillith has plans, and there's a red fez at the thrift store you've been eyeing for weeks.

CB5B6A64-FDC1-44EB-806D-D6C481665DDA.blurb: You were the best racer there was. Were. Now it's your first day as a hotel parking valet, the first car is pulling up, and you feel like you might vomit.

D2538F06-739E-42B0-9893-8B8B38922BCA.blurb: Singapore Town, 1892. You are Hexia Lee, former mechahacker and private zombie tracker, and the Raffles Yard Zombie Investigators have a job for you. You need the money.

D8B31E3B-E2F3-4A44-9BE9-7E61D0800E2F.blurb: After decades asleep in your earthen nest, you wake, stretch your little furry arms and wonder whether your shadow is waiting above. Or you could just hit snooze.

DA65B4F9-1F88-4581-B83B-8C5425240F95.blurb: You wake in a maze with no memory of how you got there. Dark walls, passages in every direction, and a map drawn one corridor at a time.

DDF6B5A7-64C7-4777-94AC-8716FB142A62.blurb: It's your first day as trainee assistant librarian at Miskatonic University, Arkham. Look after the key to the occult books cupboard, and mind the patrons.

F552971B-6327-49BD-A97A-FD9CEB7016CF.blurb: Your weekend job at the Mitchell, Michaels & Maybee Funeral Home has you making lists of things you aren't afraid of. It's Saturday morning, and you have to go to work.

F7F86EA5-1CDD-4341-8087-7E2CB4F21D2A.blurb: Drinking your coffee on the porch at Iðnó, you see the pond bulge and darken beneath. Nobody else noticed. Good thing you brought your backpack.

F9C396D2-DED4-43F0-A3BE-2ED9030EB79A.blurb: It's the scariest house you've ever seen, and Jeanine Janeeny, your worst best friend, wants to go inside. Of course she does.

FF03EDE6-6FA9-4107-BDDD-B7133CE9BABC.blurb: Wandering the Minneapolis Institute of Arts, your inner cynic is winning. Your doctor says it will be the death of you, so maybe take your medication. Or punch the art.
